card.name: Mixed spots in dosing and interaction text
card.fires_on: Scattered positions in dosing and drug-interaction sentences, such as partway through concomitant, phenytoin or anticoagulants, or after 'with or without'. No single word or setting ties them together.

modes.label: Partway through long words
modes.description: Fires inside a longer drug or medical word that is split into pieces.

modes.label: End of a dosing phrase
modes.description: Fires on the last word of a phrase about how to take a dose, such as food or water.
modes.example: Avanafil tablets may be taken with or without<< food>>.

card.plain: It fires at scattered points in dosing and interaction text with no single clear theme.
